description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'MyMetaKeyKeyListener' that manages the behavior of meta keys (shift, alt, symbol) and their states (locked, pressed, used, released) for handling keyboard input in an Android environment. It includes methods for querying and adjusting meta key states, as well as handling key down and key up events related to these meta keys.

classes.name: MyMetaKeyKeyListener
classes.description: An abstract class that encapsulates the behavior for handling meta keys (shift, alt, symbol) and their various states (locked, pressed, used, released) in Android keyboard input processing.

methods.name: getMetaState
methods.description: Returns the combined meta key state (shift, alt, symbol) as an integer bitmask based on the provided long state.

methods.name: getMetaState
methods.description: Returns the state (inactive, active, locked) of a specific meta key (shift, alt, symbol) based on the provided long state.

methods.name: adjustMetaAfterKeypress
methods.description: Resets or updates the meta key states after a key press event to prepare for subsequent input.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key down events for meta keys (shift, alt, symbol) and updates the meta state accordingly.

methods.name: handleKeyUp
methods.description: Handles key up events for meta keys and updates the meta state accordingly.
